سئة: سِئَةٌ of a bow, and 🡻سُؤَةٌ, (Ibn-Málik, Az, ISd, K, TA,) and 🡻سَأَةٌ, (Ibn-Málik, K, TA,) [in the CK erroneously written ساءَة, and it is there implied that the other vars. are سِيْئَةٌ and سُوْءَةٌ,] dial. vars. of سِيَةٌ, (K, &c.,) i. e. The curved extremity thereof. (TA.) [See also art. سيو.]
